decisive_items: a 5 × 5 cm swelling of the left labia majora without signs of inflammation
response.rationale: R1 aligns with the post-antibiotic reexamination findings: a firm, non-cystic, non-inflamed 5×5 cm labial mass in a sexually naïve patient, consistent with vulvar cancer. R2 and C1 rely on the initial clinical diagnosis of Bartholin's abscess, which is directly contradicted by the firm (not cystic) nature and resolution of inflammation after antibiotics, making them untenable.

rejected.why: Contradicted by firm non-cystic mass and resolution of inflammation; initial diagnosis was revised.
Append-only completion of R2 inherits the same contradiction and adds no independent support.
